faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Counsellor post at IIM Lucknow is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology with 1st Class, or M.Phil. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology with 1st Class, or Ph.D. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, 02 years of relevant post-qualification experience in counselling, including both group and individual counselling, in an educational institution or mental healthcare clinic/hospital/institution is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Counsellor post is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 1,02,620 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIM Lucknow Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Lucknow on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Counsellor post at IIM Lucknow.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.
